rules.summary: <CssBaseline /> mounted inside a guest widget
rules.remediation: Remove <CssBaseline />; the host shell owns global resets.

rules.summary: var(...) passed to a createTheme palette colour (crashes augmentColor)
rules.remediation: Keep palette.*.main/light/dark/contrastText free of var(); attach CSS variables through components.<Mui*>.styleOverrides.

rules.summary: Hardcoded hex/rgb/hsl colour literal
rules.remediation: Use a host token with a fallback, e.g. var(--primaryForeground, #212121), or UI_TOKENS. Colour literals belong only in tokens/ or in a var() fallback.

rules.summary: var(--token, #fallback) differs from the value in tokens/ui.ts
rules.remediation: Use the fallback defined for this token in tokens/ui.ts.

rules.summary: font-family declared; the host shell owns the font stack
rules.remediation: Delete it, including font: shorthand, codeFont/monospace stacks and token maps. Only fontFamily: "inherit" is allowed, in the createTheme theme provider or a chart-library theme, so MUI/Nivo use the host font instead of their defaults.

rules.summary: Hardcoded corner radius
rules.remediation: Use var(--borderRadius, 4px), var(--borderRadiusSm, 2px), var(--borderRadiusLarge, 8px), UI_TOKENS.shape.*, 50% or 9999px.

rules.summary:
Raw HTML text element (

, ,

-

,
rules.remediation: Use <Typography variant="..."> from @mui/material.

rules.summary: <Typography> colour set through sx or style
rules.remediation: Primary text needs no colour (it inherits). Otherwise use the color prop: color="text.secondary", "inherit" or "error".

rules.summary: Inline sx colour override on a standard MUI control
rules.remediation: Remove color/bgcolor/backgroundColor/borderColor from the control's sx; VertiGisThemeProvider supplies control colours and states.

rules.summary: <Typography> fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight or letterSpacing set through sx or style
rules.remediation: Delete the font properties and pick the matching variant (for example variant="h6" or "body2"); the theme's type scale is the token.

rules.summary: Declaration that changes nothing: minHeight equal to height, imperceptible letterSpacing, display: block inside a flex/grid parent, or a child colour equal to its parent's
rules.remediation: Delete the declaration. Parent/child checks only see JSX nested in the same file.

rules.summary: Re-declares a value the component already inherits from the host panel
rules.remediation: Delete color: var(--primaryForeground), background: var(--primaryBackground) and <Typography color="text.primary">. Opaque layers (position sticky/fixed/absolute or z-index) and the createTheme provider are exempt; suppress portal roots with a reason.

rules.summary: Text and background tokens from different pairs (risk of unreadable text such as white on white)
rules.remediation: Set background and foreground together from the same pair: XBackground with XForeground, accent fills with emphasizedButtonForeground, surfaces with primaryForeground/secondaryForeground/errorHelperTextForeground. Never use a Foreground token as a background or a Background token as text.

rules.summary: Text token on its background is below WCAG AA 4.5:1 (light-theme fallback values)
rules.remediation: Choose a text token with enough contrast on that surface; fallbacks resolve from tokens/ui.ts first. Disabled text is exempt.

rules.summary: Interactive element without an accessible name or keyboard handler
rules.remediation: Add aria-label to IconButton and label (or aria-label) to TextField. In Workflow, custom clickable elements with onClick also need onKeyDown.

rules.summary: Component is not wrapped in an error boundary
rules.remediation: Wrap the view in <ErrorBoundary> (Web) or <FormElementErrorBoundary> (Workflow).

rules.summary: Star import of an @arcgis/core class module
rules.remediation: Use a default import for class modules: import Graphic from "@arcgis/core/Graphic". Keep star imports for utility modules.

rules.summary: Source file exceeds the 150-line target
rules.remediation: Decompose into components/, hooks/, utils/, tokens/ and types/.

rules.summary: Source file exceeds the 250-line hard ceiling
rules.remediation: Refactor before continuing: extract sub-components, hooks and pure helpers.

rules.summary: Legacy MUI prop (InputProps, inputProps, PaperProps, BackdropProps, onBackdropClick)
rules.remediation: Use slotProps, e.g. slotProps={{ input: { readOnly } }} or slotProps={{ paper: { className } }}; use onClose instead of onBackdropClick.

rules.summary: Deep @mui/material/<path> import, or @mui/styles
rules.remediation: Import from "@mui/material" ("@mui/material/styles" is allowed for createTheme/ThemeProvider). Do not use @mui/styles.

rules.summary: Suppression comment without a reason, with a wildcard, or with an unknown rule ID
rules.remediation: Write: // vertigis-rule-disable RULE_ID -- <reason>  or  /* vertigis-rule-disable-file RULE_ID -- <reason> */.

rules.summary: createTheme palette hardcodes colours, or MuiTypography styleOverrides set color
rules.remediation: Keep createTheme palettes to mode plus token-driven values from src/tokens/; never set color in components.MuiTypography.styleOverrides.

rules.summary: Theme provider or non-CSS renderer does not follow the shell theme
rules.remediation: Drive createTheme and chart/canvas/PDF renderers from useIsDarkTheme() (React) or isDarkTheme() (non-React).

rules.summary: Raw var(--token, #hex) string in TS/TSX outside src/tokens/
rules.remediation: Consume the colour through UI_TOKENS or the co-located CSS file.

rules.summary: :root declared in component CSS
rules.remediation: Declare layout variables on the namespaced component selector, e.g. .ListHeader { --row-height: 36px; }.

rules.summary: Custom property re-aliases another token (--x: var(--y))
rules.remediation: Consume the official host token directly with its fallback, e.g. var(--primaryBackground, #ffffff).

rules.summary: Generic, non-namespaced CSS class (e.g. .header, .title, .card, .active)
rules.remediation: Namespace with the component name or BEM: .ListHeader-title or .list-header__title.

rules.summary: .Mui* class targeted from CSS
rules.remediation: Let VertiGisThemeProvider style MUI controls; use component styleOverrides only for intentional divergence.

rules.summary: !important in CSS (only display: none !important is allowed)
rules.remediation: Remove !important; fix specificity instead.

rules.summary: CSS class is never referenced in source
rules.remediation: Delete the unused class.

rules.summary: Top-level class defined in more than one CSS file
rules.remediation: Define each top-level class in exactly one CSS file.

rules.summary: <GlobalStyles> targets div[role="dialog"] or .MuiDialogContent-root
rules.remediation: Remove the global override; set dialog size in app.json or layout.xml.

rules.summary: Inline sx={{ }} object
rules.remediation: Move styles into a Record<string, SxProps<Theme>> dictionary.

rules.summary: Inline sx={{ }} on a layout element (Box, Stack, Grid, Container, div, span, img)
rules.remediation: Layout is not an MUI control: move it into a component CSS class that uses var(--token, #fallback) values.

rules.summary: style={{ }} holds fixed values
rules.remediation: Move fixed values to the co-located ComponentName.css; keep style={{ }} for runtime values only.

rules.summary: Element combines className with a static style={{ }}
rules.remediation: Use one styling method; move the rendered inline value into the CSS rule.

rules.summary: UI control imported from @vertigis/web/ui
rules.remediation: Import controls from @mui/material; use @vertigis/web/ui only for hooks such as useWatchAndRerender.

rules.summary: Model declares its own _handles field (overwrites the inherited Handles instance)
rules.remediation: Delete the field. Use this._handles.add(...) or a domain-specific name such as _eventHandles.

rules.summary: super._onInitialize() is not first, or super._onDestroy() is not last
rules.remediation: Call await super._onInitialize() as the first statement of _onInitialize and await super._onDestroy() as the last statement of _onDestroy.

rules.summary: Component model defined in a view file, or JSX in a model file
rules.remediation: Keep the model in *Model.ts without JSX and the view in *.tsx.

rules.summary: View reads model state without observer(), or observer is not imported from mobx-react-lite
rules.remediation: import { observer } from "mobx-react-lite" and export observer(View).

rules.summary: Component view does not render <LayoutElement {...props}>
rules.remediation: Wrap the view content in <LayoutElement {...props}> from @vertigis/web/components.

rules.summary: View hides itself when props.active is false
rules.remediation: Remove the active check; the host tab container manages visibility.

rules.summary: Designer writes an empty string attribute (node.attributes.set(key, ""))
rules.remediation: Trim the value; call node.attributes.delete(key) when empty.
